Post 1

📈 ASX 200 hit a 100-day high Wednesday, up 82pts or 0.90% to 9,227.80 — just 0.02% off its 52-week high. Materials surged while Energy bled. The market is telling a clear story: hard assets in, hydrocarbons out. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials led all sectors at +3.56%, dragging the index higher. IT added +2.51%, Health Care +1.70%. Energy was the clear laggard at -2.22%, Utilities -1.62%. Two very different economies trading side by side today. #ASX #mining #energy

Post 3

NEU surged +16.28% to AUD 21.64 — the session's standout mover inside the ASX 200. Neuren Pharmaceuticals drove Health Care's +1.70% sector gain almost single-handedly. When one stock moves that hard, the sector number flatters the rest. #ASX #healthcare #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,929.69/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7041. A softer local currency amplifies gold returns for domestic holders. Silver at AUD 88.26/oz. Metals strength aligns directly with Materials sector outperformance today. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

🔻 Woodside fell 3.55% to AUD 31.78 — watch Energy sector pressure. If oil stays soft overnight, WDS and peers face another session of selling. Does Energy find a floor this week, or does Materials keep widening the gap? Drop your call below. #ASX #energy #ausbiz
